Title: Freelance Product Data Technician
HTML:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace.

CREATIVE OPERATIONS
We're a creative family, building copy, data, and visual assets for each corner of the Farfetch E-commerce Platform. We are dedicated to providing gold-standard imagery, content, and digital production services for our partners and creating an engaging on-site experience for our customers.

THE ROLE
You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of information collected through various processes. Your main responsibility will be to do online research, identify identical items across sources, and maintain/ add and/or create accurate product information in our systems. You'll be tasked with identifying inconsistencies and extracting critical product details.

What You'll Do

  • Analyse, create and/or edit information of the items that arrive production accordingly to our guidelines;
  • Identify similar products across multiple sources;
  • Verify and validate product information to ensure accuracy and completeness by cross-referencing across multiple sources;
  • Compare product information to determine if items are the same or different, identifying variations in attributes such as name, description, and other specifications;
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies found during the validation process, documenting issues and communicating findings effectively to relevant stakeholders;
  • Use the internal platform to register and monitor data quality;
  • Analyse product defects and identify actions required to resolve them




Who You Are

  • 1+ years of experience in e-commerce, sales or related field a plus;
  • Intermediate Excel skills;
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to spot patterns, anomalies, and inconsistencies;
  • Ability to prioritise and multi-task without compromising on quality standards;
  • Abstraction, ability to learn new things and work with new tools;

Title: Flow Engineer
Description:
Job Type

Fixed Term

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

Role Overview

The Flow Engineering is a hands-on technical coach and delivery expert focused on optimizing the speed, efficiency, and quality of product development across one or more Value Stream squads within the RE business unit.

This role is critical for driving the adoption of Lean, XP and Agile principles, specifically targeting the improvement of flow metrics (Lead Time, Throughput, Efficiency) and the reduction of waste and friction within the delivery pipeline. You will mentor development squads, support Product Owners, and champion continuous improvement to enhance the overall value engine.

About Hiscox Re

Hiscox Re is located in Bermuda and London and underwrites reinsurance risks from around the world on behalf of our own and other people’s capital. The team of over 100 smart, enthusiastic individuals are committed to providing top quality service to brokers and clients across a broad range of reinsurance products. Our approach is simple; match the best underwriting risk against globally diversified capital. Our proactive, product-led underwriting approach is complemented by a commitment to world class service and purpose-built analytics and systems. We know our people are our biggest asset so finding and retaining the best talent is critical to achieving our vision.

Key Responsibilities


Delivery Flow Optimisation
Value Stream Mapping: Collaborate with development squads and stakeholders to understand the end-to-end flow of value, from concept to delivery, actively identifying bottlenecks and opportunities for Lean process improvements.
Flow Metrics & Measurement: Collect, analyse, and present data on key flow metrics (Cycle Time, Lead Time, Throughput, WIP, Work Item Flow Efficiency). Use these insights to drive process improvements and hold squads accountable for owning their flow.
Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous incremental delivery. Focus squads on working software and user satisfaction as the primary measures of progress, using data and stakeholder feedback to iterate on products and initiatives.
Blocker Resolution: Take ownership across multiple cross-disciplined squads, actively assisting them in resolving external blockers, technical issues, and managing dependency reduction. Although the squads and product owners remain accountable for delivery and deployment of value on a frequent basis.
Squad Coaching, Enablement, Culture and Health
Squad Mentoring: Mentor and coach development squads on flow-focused practices, empowering them to self-organize and make decisions that improve their efficiency. Upskill stakeholders on Lean and Agile practices.
Standards Definition: Help squads define and adhere to their Definition of a Workflow, Service Level Expectations (SLEs), and Definition of Done (DoD) to ensure consistency and quality.
Technical Practices: Leverage your knowledge of technical subjects (SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, architecture) to guide squads in adopting modern engineering practices that enhance delivery flow.
Team Culture: work with the squads to improve the overall culture – that supports psychological safety, staff inclusivity and engagement – use regular survey results to help the squad identify positive actions that may improve culture over time. Encourage team members to get involved in communities of practice and share knowledge on a frequent basis with the wider Hiscox Technology Community.
Squad Health & Stakeholder Engagement: work with the squad members to ensure work practices support sustainability and the resilience of its members. Ensure we can track squad health through metrics – allowing us to see when additional leadership support is needed. Also capture engagement metrics – as a lack of engagement from business stakeholders can have a dramatic impact on overall squad performance. Help to resolve any engagement issues if they do occur.
Stakeholder & Portfolio Support
Backlog Prioritisation Support: Work closely with Product Owners (POs) to help them ensure backlogs are appropriately prioritized and roadmaps reflect "delivery do-ability." Help POs manage late and ad-hoc requests by balancing business priorities against existing delivery commitments.
Communication & Reporting: Communicate the status of product development, flow improvements, and overall improvement initiatives. Present relevant flow and squad health and engagement data to stakeholders to aid effective business decision-making.
Facilitation and Collaboration Leading and facilitate department events that support collaboration, knowledge‑sharing, and strategic priorities.
Strategic Alignment: Work alongside POs to ensure the delivery process aligns with clear business objectives and customer needs. Challenge requests or competing demands that would negatively impact existing delivery commitments.
Chapter Contribution: Work with the other members of the RE Flow Engineering, wider Hiscox Flow Engineering chapters and Product Owner Chapters to share knowledge, best practices, and contribute to the overall maturity of the practice.



Required Experience And Structure


Reporting: Reports into the Re Flow Engineering Manager
Key Partners: Value Stream Product Managers and Product Owners, Development Squads (Engineers), Head of Strategic Change, and Head of Engineering.



Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced, technically-aware delivery lead

er with a passion for continuous improvement and a strong background in Lean/Flow principles. You must be comfortable coaching technical teams, challenging stakeholders on delivery practices, and using data to drive optimal execution and maximum value creation within a complex product environment.

Main Experience Required Is


Detailed knowledge of, and experience working with, Agile frameworks (e.g., Kanban, XP, Lean, Scrum).
3+ years’ experience in a dedicated delivery role (Product Owner, Flow Enablement Lead, Scrum Master).
Proven ability to understand and interpret flow metrics, identifying areas for improvement and coaching accountability.
Knowledge of technical subjects, including architecture, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and other modern engineering practices
Experience with delivery management tools (e.g. JIRA, Miro, Confluence, Azure DevOps).
Experience with support of live complex solutions, Incident/Problem management including major incident management.
Knowledge of project management, delivering within an environment of Programme / Portfolio of change.



If you are a visionary with a growth mindset and a passion for driving positive change and transformation through creating a healthy culture, we invite you to apply for the position of Flow Engineering Lead at Hiscox Re. Join our team and be a catalyst for transformation in a dynamic and forward-thinking organization.

Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

  • Realizar exames de imagiologia nas diversas valências de Radiologia Convencional, Mamografia, Tomografia Axial Computorizada; Ressonância Magnética e Ortopantomografia;
  • Programar, executar e avaliar as técnicas imagiológicas utilizadas em diagnóstico;
  • Preparar e posicionar o utente para a execução de exames, assegurando a sua vigilância durante a execução dos mesmos;

  • Conhecer e utilizar técnicas e normas de proteção e segurança radiológica, mantendo a utilização da radiação ionizante a níveis baixos e de segurança, de forma a assegurar a sua proteção e a do utente;

  • Licenciatura em Radiologia ou Imagem Médica e Radioterapia;

Se sentes que este desafio é para ti e reúnes os requisitos pretendidos, submete a tua candidatura e vem fazer a diferença connosco.

Foster engineering excellence by encouraging best practices and continuous learning.

Independently resolve complex technical challenges and unblock development teams.
Investigate root causes, prototype solutions, and escalate strategically when appropriate.
Provide technical guidance on high-complexity implementation decisions.

Ensure technical documentation remains accurate and up to date.
Promote consistency across the codebase through governance and technical leadership.

Champion a quality-first engineering culture through leadership by example.

Proactively identify opportunities for refactoring, performance optimization, and technical debt reduction.
Drive engineering initiatives beyond assigned tasks to improve maintainability and scalability.
Contribute to the evolution of frontend architecture and development processes.

Act as the go-to engineer for high-risk or technically challenging components.
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Frontend Development

5+ years of professional experience developing applications with React.
Advanced expertise in React Hooks, Context API, component architecture, and performance optimization.
Strong proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced typing, generics, and scalable type design.

State Management & Data Fetching

Experience with modern state management solutions such as Zustand, Context API, or similar.
Strong knowledge of TanStack Query (React Query) for asynchronous state management, caching, and data synchronization.

Routing

Solid experience with React Router, including nested routing, lazy loading, route guards, and advanced navigation patterns.

Design Systems

Experience consuming, contributing to, or building Design Systems.
Strong understanding of reusable component libraries, design tokens, theming, and documentation tools such as Storybook.

API Integration

Strong understanding of REST APIs, including:
HTTP methods;
status codes;
authentication mechanisms;
error handling;
API design principles.

Testing

Experience writing unit and integration tests using Vitest and Testing Library.
Commitment to maintaining high test coverage and code quality.

Build Tools & Performance

Experience with Vite and Rsbuild.
Understanding of modern frontend tooling, bundle optimization, web performance, and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of Core Web Vitals and frontend performance optimization techniques.

Accessibility

Understanding of WCAG accessibility standards and best practices for accessible web applications.

Version Control

Strong experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Microfrontend architectures (Module Federation, single-spa, or similar).
Experience with Server-Side Rendering (SSR), hydration, and React frameworks such as Next.js or Remix.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise environments involving multiple engineering teams contributing to shared applications.
Contributions to open-source React or frontend projects.
Previous experience in technical mentoring, engineering leadership, or facilitating technical workshops.

Position Highlights

Opportunity to work in a large-scale enterprise environment with mature engineering processes.
Significant influence on frontend architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction.
Collaboration with highly experienced senior engineers.
Dedicated time for technical improvements, innovation, and continuous learning.
Competitive compensation package with flexible working arrangements and a collaborative culture.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong mentoring mindset with a genuine passion for developing others.
High level of ownership, accountability, and solution-oriented thinking.
Empathy when designing maintainable solutions suitable for teams with varying experience levels.
Humility, curiosity, and commitment to continuous learning.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Description:
Do you want to be part of the change?

Then, you’re in the right place. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future for our clients and our teams… But we can’t do that without you!

By joining BNP Paribas Personal Finance, take part in our great transformation towards building a more sustainable world: we are committed to promoting access to more responsible and sustainable consumption to support our customers and partners.

To achieve this, we implement concrete actions, not only in the way we develop our business and enhance our sustainable growth, with the ambition to reduce our environmental footprint, but also in the way we support those who need it most.

Our analytical teams use state-of-the-art data science and visualization techniques to solve business issues and uncover opportunities for BNP Paribas Person Finance. Our team is embedded in the business context, and we ensure that we deliver fast, stable, and scalable data and AI solutions with a measurable impact for our stakeholders. We have vast amounts of data in the Bank, and we know that the value will come with robust solutions deployed in production.

In practice, your day-to-day

About

Integrated in the Marketing, B2C & B2B scope, the Data Scientist will collect information about customer behavior. You will mainly use Python, SAS and SQL tools to:


Develop, maintain and validate data workflows, guaranteeing the quality of our data assets
Design, create and adapt statistical/ML/AI predictive and decisional models - mainly classifiers, scores, segmentations, churn models, time series analyses.
Deploy the solutions or execute them in batch and validate their metrics during implementation, such as in relational marketing.
Brief stakeholders on the setup, gains and possible evolution of your solutions, and align with offer, relational, communication and business on optimizing our value proposition.
Create one-off analyses and prototypes, design and run test&learn experiments to develop new business and marketing strategies.
Interact with IT, data, operational, and financial teams to ensure data flows, process integration, and standardized analyses and pipelines.
Ensure high quality delivery, in both data extractions, data quality checks, run performance, and code quality.


The Mission is important, but so is the Team and the workplace!

Welcome to BNP Paribas Personal Finance, where you will integrate the Marketing Analytics team, composed of specialized, innovative and team-spirited individuals, and based in Lisbon and Porto.

We will accommodate you with an initial integration plan, on-the-job learning, training resources, and networking opportunities.

What do we have to offer you?

This is a very important topic that we’ll discuss together, based on your specific experience and education.

For Now, We Highlight The Following Benefits


Flexible Benefits Platform (benefit+): package that considers benefits in areas such as protection, education and well-being, and which always includes Health Insurance, extendable to your family, and Life Insurance
Extra vacation days, up to 31, depending on seniority and volunteering
Partnerships with thousands of entities that give access to some advantages (tourism, food, hospitality, fashion, technology...
Personal Credit to employees, under advantageous conditions compared to the market
Smart working policy
24-hour helpline available in case you need psychological, legal, financial/tax and psychosocial support


Are you the one we are looking for?


Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or related field
Strong programming and scripting skills in Python
Quantitative analysis skills and applied knowledge about machine learning, statistical analysis (AB testing, significance tests, uplift models), churn models, optimization?
Good knowledge of data workflows: SQL and ETL processes
Proficiency in git
Good communication and organization skills, initiative, focus on delivery
Good level of English
Optional: previous experience in a financial or technological or research environment, knowledge of SAS (or ability to become proficient in PROC SQL and macros), working in agile mode, CI/CD processes


If you have all this, motivation, energy and a good mood, then you are the one we are seeking...

We look forward to your application!

Our commitments

BNP Paribas Personal Finance is an equal opportunity employer that is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all job seekers. As a socially responsible company, we incorporate the principles of Diversity and Inclusion in our values and practices.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

Role Details

📍 Job location: Portugal / Remote within Europe

🕒 Contract type: Employee/ Contractor B2B

🗓 Target start date: September 2026

⏰ Working hours: Full-time (40h/week)

💵 Compensation: 45k gross year to 60k gross year / or B2B 280 to 350 euros/day

📋 What You'll Architect

As an AI Engineer, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making.

This role is both technical and consultative — perfect for someone who can combine AI solution development, LLM engineering, and a strong Data Engineering foundation to deliver scalable and production-ready intelligent systems. We’re looking for professionals who think like architects and act like builders.

Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain LLM-powered pipelines for processing and automating customer requests.
Design and implement data ingestion, data preprocessing, and enrichment pipelines for unstructured data sources, including emails, PDFs, images, and documents.
Develop classification, routing, and decision workflows for customer inquiries.
Apply prompt engineering best practices and continuously improve model performance and output quality.
Implement structured outputs and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows to ensure reliability and business adoption.
Ensure production readiness through testing, CI/CD, containerisation, and monitoring.
Contribute to AI architecture design, scalability, and engineering standards.
Monitor, evaluate, and optimise AI systems using LLM observability tools and performance metrics.
Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and business teams to integrate AI solutions into existing processes and workflows.


👤 Who You Are


You are an experienced AI Engineer with a strong background in Data Engineering, comfortable working across the entire lifecycle of intelligent applications.
You enjoy building practical AI solutions that solve real business problems rather than experimenting with technology for its own sake.
You are passionate about LLMs, Generative AI, and modern data platforms, while maintaining a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
You balance software engineering discipline, data engineering expertise, and AI innovation.
You are comfortable working autonomously and taking ownership of complex technical initiatives from design through deployment.
You thrive in collaborative, international environments and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are naturally curious and continuously explore new approaches, tools, and frameworks within the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem.
You communicate clearly and effectively and can explain complex technical concepts in an accessible way.


🛠️ What You Bring

Qualifications & Experience


5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, AI Engineering, or related fields.
Strong professional experience developing production-grade Python applications.
Proven experience building and maintaining LLM-based solutions and intelligent workflows.
Experience working with unstructured data processing pipelines.
Ability to work independently in multidisciplinary and distributed teams.
Professional proficiency in English.


Technical & Professional Skills


Strong expertise in: Python; FastAPI; Async programming patterns; REST APIs; and PostgreSQL
Hands-on experience with OpenAI SDK, LangChain, LangGraph or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
Strong experience in Prompt Engineering, LLM evaluation, Structured outputs and Human-in-the-Loop workflows
Solid Data Engineering background, including data pipelines, ingestion, preprocessing and working with unstructured datasets
Experience with: Docker; CI/CD pipelines; testing practices; and production deployments
Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, or similar.


Nice to Have


German or French proficiency is highly valued
Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or other event-driven architectures.
Experience with Langfuse or other LLM observability platforms.
Experience within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including Container Apps, IAM, KEDA, and secrets management.
Knowledge of Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Experience building distributed processing systems and async worker architectures.
Previous consulting or client-facing experience.


⭐ What Makes You Successful


You focus on delivering business-ready AI solutions, not just technical prototypes.
You combine strong Data Engineering fundamentals with modern LLM and Generative AI expertise.
You design systems with scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability in mind.
You proactively identify opportunities to improve automation, efficiency, and customer experience through AI.
You approach AI challenges with both experimentation and engineering discipline.
You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and translating business requirements into practical technical solutions.
You continuously optimise model performance, observability, and operational excellence.
You actively share knowledge and contribute to stronger engineering standards across teams.
You combine autonomy, ownership, and collaboration to deliver measurable outcomes.


🎁 What We Offer at Keyrus Portugal


Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the data market
Meal allowance: €10.20/day
Flexible benefits plan
Private medical insurance
22 days of annual leave, increasing every 3 years (up to 25 days)
Continuous learning via KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience
A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment


💰 How Our Salary Ranges Work

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role — not different job titles.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the Patchman team. You'll work hands-on with Patchman's existing and legacy infrastructure, helping stabilize, modernize, and integrate it with our broader platform. This includes tackling technical debt, improving reliability and performance, optimizing infrastructure costs, and simplifying systems and processes along the way. Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain the Patchman backend infrastructure
Develop and maintain new product features, from design through implementation and testing
Investigate and resolve complex issues reported by customers, digging deep into the codebase to identify root causes
Operate and maintain a large fleet of dedicated servers, including API gateways, load balancers, and internal processing nodes
Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines for efficient, automated delivery
Write and maintain comprehensive unit/integration tests to ensure code quality
Monitor performance and reliability of production systems, proactively identifying areas for improvement
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine architecture and contribute to technical direction



Requirements


5+ years of professional experience as a Backend or DevOps Developer
Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language
Experience designing backend services, with a solid understanding of performance, concurrency, scalability, and reliability
Hands-on experience building and running high-throughput data pipelines at scale using Apache Kafka, ClickHouse, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies
Experience with SQL databases, such as PostgreSQL, and in-memory databases, such as Redis
Strong understanding of different data storage paradigms, including relational, NoSQL, and in-memory key-value databases
Practical experience with Docker and Docker Compose for local development and production deployments
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
Experience working with monitoring systems
Solid understanding of CI/CD best practices, including Git, automated testing, and deployment workflows
Excellent debugging skills and the ability to investigate complex technical issues
Analytical mindset and the ability to interpret metrics and user feedback to make data-driven decisions
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Upper-intermediate spoken and written English



Nice to have


Experience working with Django
Experience with configuration management systems, such as Puppet, Ansible, Salt, or similar tools



What We're Looking For

We value engineers who are:


Curious and fearless problem solvers - not afraid to dig into existing systems, investigate root causes, and propose improvements
Pragmatic and detail-oriented - focused on building reliable, maintainable systems
Team players - comfortable collaborating in a distributed team environment and contributing to a shared mission



Benefits


What's in it for you?


A focus on professional development
Interesting and challenging projects
Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide
Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves
Compensation for private medical insurance
Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement
Budget for education

Title: Data Science Associate (Fashion)
Description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for a Data Science Associate to join our Data and Analytics team in our Digital Campus in Porto.

Who We Are

The next step of your career starts here, where you can bring your own unique mix of skills and perspectives to a fast-growing team.

Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering AI & Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.

What We Offer


Opportunity to accelerate the pace of digitalization through advanced technology, business intelligence, and analytics.
Driving high-impact insights enhancing decision making across the entire organization.
Interaction with senior business leaders on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.
Become part of a fast-growing international and diverse team.



What You Will Do


Conduct advanced data analysis focused on Operations, Finance and Supply Chain (specific for our team).
Translate business problems into analytical solutions, from requirement gathering to model deployment and monitoring.
Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models (e.g. Churn, CLV, Segmentation, Personalization) using modern MLOps frameworks (e.g. MLflow, Git).
Leverage Databricks, Azure, or similar cloud infrastructure for scalable data processing and model deployment.
Use Python, PySpark, and common ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.) for data transformation, model development, and evaluation.
Apply statistical methods (e.g. hypothesis testing, A/B testing, confidence intervals) to validate performance and drive actionable insights.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly through compelling storytelling and visualizations.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Business teams, Data Engineering, IT teams) and contribute to customer-centric strategies.
Support team development through knowledge sharing, collaboration, and participation in agile working models.



What You Will Bring


3–5 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, ideally in retail or e-commerce.
A master's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering.
Proven ability to manage the full lifecycle of an ML solution; business understanding, data wrangling, and modelling, to production deployment and monitoring.
Hands-on experience with MLflow, Git, and MLOps frameworks.
Solid programming skills in Python, including libraries like pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn, and PySpark.
Experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS, especially in the context of Databricks, data pipelines, and model hosting.
Good understanding of data warehousing and querying using SQL.
Familiarity with statistical concepts (e.g. experiment design, hypothesis testing, p-values).
Experience or strong interest in Generative AI applications, such as LLM-based solutions, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted analytics is a plus.
Exposure to Reinforcement Learning concepts is a plus, especially in areas like decision optimization, personalization, or next-best-action use cases.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present technical insights to non-technical audiences.
Fluency in English (written and spoken).
Experience within the retail and fashion industry (nice to have).
Experience within international environments, consultancy, or a start-up environment (nice to have).



In a changing world, diversity and inclusion are core values for team well-being and performance. At Metyis, we want to welcome and retain all talents, regardless of gender, age, origin or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether or not they are living with a disability, as each of them has their own experience and identity.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the Data Scientist (Machine learning Ops) you will be part of our Digital Services unit at Gas Services in Siemens Energy and work on challenging projects from all areas of the energy industry. Through combining strategic and business insights with the latest analytical techniques, you help our Business Units to drive maximum value from data and develop analytics solutions that provide strategic advantages in their day-to-day operations.

How You’ll Make An Impact


Work as a Subject Matter Expert in a global team, developing advanced analytics solutions across the value-chain.
Create data mining architectures, models, protocols, and methodologies for statistical and data analysis to identify patterns in heterogeneous datasets.
Design and develop AI concepts using research and latest trends to address customer challenges effectively.
Apply tools and methods broadly across various business areas, ensuring versatility and impact.
Stay updated on data science principles, theories, and techniques to support data-driven business decisions.
Document and share methods, processes, and project results, regularly communicating and presenting findings as part of the ED&AA global team.



What You Bring


Possess working knowledge and experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI, with expertise in AWS SageMaker.
Skilled in serverless technologies (Python, .NET), data warehousing systems, and setting up target database systems.
Demonstrate excellent analytical skills and expertise in statistical modeling, with strong programming skills in Python and/or R.
Experience in deploying data analytics models using technologies like Docker and cloud services for data analytics is beneficial.
Strong customer focus, excellent communication skills, and ability to navigate global, multicultural environments; industry-related experience is a plus.
Passionate about data and analytics, driving data value across organizations, and excelling in team collaboration and multidisciplinary environments.



About The Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Competitive salary and meal allowance
Fair compensation for international work
Health insurance coverage
Remote work permitted within Portugal
Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Data Scientist to join our team. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of data science and engineering. You'll work directly with clients to deploy, adapt, and integrate JTA's data science and machine learning solutions into their real-world environments, bridging the gap between the models and systems we build and the operational needs on the ground. You'll combine strong data science know-how with solid software engineering skills to make sure our solutions deliver tangible, measurable value in production.

 

What you will be doing:




Work closely with clients to understand their data landscape, technical environment, and business objectives, translating these into effective data science deployment strategies.
Deploy, configure, and integrate JTA's data science and ML solutions into client systems, ensuring models run reliably and deliver value in production.
Adapt and extend existing models and data pipelines to fit client-specific data, constraints, and requirements, writing robust, maintainable code across the stack.
Act as a technical bridge between clients and JTA's internal data science and engineering teams, relaying feedback and shaping solutions accordingly.
Troubleshoot issues across data pipelines and production models, monitoring performance and providing hands-on support to ensure solutions perform as intended.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and the sales team to translate data science outcomes into clear business value.




Requirements:




Bachelor's or Master's in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in data science, machine learning deployment, or a similar hands-on technical role.
Solid understanding of data science and machine learning concepts, with practical experience adapting models to real-world data and constraints.
Strong programming skills in Python, including the data science ecosystem (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn), with solid software engineering fundamentals (version control, testing, CI/CD).
Experience with PySpark for large-scale data processing and feature engineering.
Experience deploying and integrating data science solutions in client or production environments, including working with APIs, cloud platforms, and containerization (e.g., Docker).
Familiarity with distributed systems and the challenges of building and operating data-intensive solutions at scale.
Excellent communication skills and a client-focused mindset, with the ability to explain models and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving situations.
Willingness to travel to client sites when needed.




Perks:




Annual gross salary between €30,000 and €40,000, depending on experience and qualifications, with room for flexibility;
Flexible Hybrid Work System;
15th Month Bonus Salary Policy;
4 extra vacation days;
Participation in International Projects;
Company-Paid Certifications;

You'll work directly with clients to deploy, adapt, and integrate JTA's data science and machine learning solutions into their real-world environments, bridging the gap between the models and systems we build and the operational needs on the ground. You'll combine strong data science know-how with solid software engineering skills to make sure our solutions deliver tangible, measurable value in production.

 

What you will be doing:


  • Work closely with clients to understand their data landscape, technical environment, and business objectives, translating these into effective data science deployment strategies.
  • Deploy, configure, and integrate JTA's data science and ML solutions into client systems, ensuring models run reliably and deliver value in production.
  • Adapt and extend existing models and data pipelines to fit client-specific data, constraints, and requirements, writing robust, maintainable code across the stack.
  • Act as a technical bridge between clients and JTA's internal data science and engineering teams, relaying feedback and shaping solutions accordingly.
  • Troubleshoot issues across data pipelines and production models, monitoring performance and providing hands-on support to ensure solutions perform as intended.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and the sales team to translate data science outcomes into clear business value.


Requirements:


  • Bachelor's or Master's in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data science, machine learning deployment, or a similar hands-on technical role.
  • Solid understanding of data science and machine learning concepts, with practical experience adapting models to real-world data and constraints.

Title: Data Scientist (Risk)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who'll effectively assess and manage risk by developing policies, methodologies, models, and systems for risk quantification, reporting, and monitoring.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing


Developing and maintaining methodologies and policies for liquidity and market derivative modelling
Delivering real impact to the product through rigorous data-driven solutions
Building, enhancing, and maintaining the core risk engine, including margin models, leverage frameworks, and liquidation logic
Developing and calibrating risk models across isolated/cross margin, partial/full liquidation, bankruptcy pricing, and future portfolio margining capabilities
Collaborating with Engineering to deploy risk methodologies into production systems while iteratively improving models based on market conditions
Automating advanced analytic workflows, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, short-term investment performance, and cash flow analysis
Preparing documentation for compliance, and presenting risk insights, exposures, and recommendations to senior leadership


What You'll Need


A degree in mathematics, statistics, financial engineering, machine learning, or computer science
3+ years of experience in machine learning, financial engineering, or similar roles within liquidity or market derivatives
Knowledge of margin trading mechanics, derivatives pricing models, and liquidation/liquidity risk management
Expertise in building and validating risk and margin models (VaR, Expected Shortfall, SPAN, CCP-style IM/VM, stress tests, scenario simulations)
Proficiency in quantitative modelling and time-series methods (GARCH, ARIMA, stochastic calculus), with advanced Python and SQL skills for large-scale data analysis
Familiarity with high-frequency datasets, and the ability to work well in fast-paced risk environments


Nice to have


Experience at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider, or within a treasury or risk department (FTP, ALM, liquidity, IRRB, etc.)
Exposure to market-making workflows and risks (inventory management, P&L drivers, spread optimisation, and internalisation strategies)
Familiarity with regulatory and institutional risk frameworks (Basel III/IV, FRTB, SA-CCR, CCP margin methodologies)


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Job Purpose

As a Data Scientist you will analyse and interpret US healthcare claims and insurance plan-level data using SQL and Python to assess prescription patterns, patient treatment journey, prescriber landscape, insurance coverage across the competitor landscape, as well as possible unmet need and market size. You will provide strategic insights and support AI use cases to inform the commercialization and go-to-market strategy for MoonLake; setup and operate analytics infrastructure for MoonLake Commercial across several data sources and platforms; and drive additional data and insights related cross-functional projects, such as scientific papers.

Major Accountabilities:


Leverage SQL and Python for efficient data extraction, manipulation, and interpretationfor patient claims andplan-level insurance data,e.g.:
Conduct in-depth analysis ofpatientlifetime treatmentjourney.
Evaluate healthcare practitioner activity across the market.
Analyse US healthcare claims data to evaluate market presence and trends among competitors.
Analyse healthcare insurance plan-level data to assess prescription market coverage.
Merge and harmonize multiple data sources for advanced analytics.
Identify gaps and opportunities in competitor insurance coverage and market positioning.
Scale and professionalize analytics infrastructure and support AI use cases for commercialization.
Ensure data quality and integrity during analysis to support accurate reporting.
Document all processes, experiments, data sources and analyses to ensure a robust and reproducible infrastructure.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver actionable insights on market trends.
Provide strategic recommendations based on data analysis to inform business decisions.
Create and maintain dashboards or reports to monitor key metrics and market performance, as well as visualize advanced analytics outcomes.

Your profile

Job Requirements:

Education: Masters in Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Data Science, Computer Science or related field with 2-5 years relevant experience or PhD with 1 years of relevant experience required.

Skills/knowledge/behavioural competencies:


Knowledge of statistics, programming, and real-world studies
Prior programming experience using medical health records, RWD or claims data is a bonus.
SQL, Python, Pandas, SkLearn, NLP, Power BI, Git, Data Visualization
Good organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills
Ability to effectively manage and prioritize multiple tasks and projects.
Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.


Why us?

An exciting job opportunity awaits you!

MoonLake is a dynamic and innovative company pushing the boundaries of possibility, and we are looking for passionate individuals to join our stellar team.

What we offer:

Learning Environment: An opportunity to learn and grow alongside experienced professionals in a supportive and innovative biotech environment.

Impactful Work: Contribute to ground-breaking projects that have the potential to transform global healthcare.

Flexibility and Balance: Work remotely/hybrid, enjoying a healthy work-life balance while making meaningful contributions to our team.

Career Growth: A clear path for career progression, with the chance to take on more responsibilities as you develop your skills.

About Us

MoonLake Immunotherapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company unlocking the potential of sonelokimab, a novel investigational Nanobody® for the treatment of the inflammatory disease, to revolutionize outcomes for patients.

We continue to make significant progress in our Global Clinical Development Programs. The company’s focus is on inflammatory diseases with a major unmet need, including hidradenitis suppurativa and psoriatic arthritis – conditions affecting millions of people worldwide with a large need for improved treatment options. MoonLake was founded in 2021 and is headquarted in Zug, with hubs in Cambridge & Porto.

Further information is available at www.moonlaketx.com

Ihre Rolle in unserem Team

Als Data Scientist (m/w/d) treiben Sie die datengetriebene Entscheidungsfindung in unserem Unternehmen voran. Sie konzipieren und entwickeln neue Datenprodukte für unseren Servicebereich, insbesondere für ein gruppenweites Reporting. Perspektivisch unterstützen Sie zudem die Organisationsentwicklung durch die Einführung und Nutzung von Process-Mining-Tools zur Prozessanalyse und -optimierung. Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie weitere datenbezogene Entwicklungsinitiativen und liefern mit Ihren Analysen wertvolle Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Ihre Arbeit stärkt eine Kultur des Datendenkens und macht datengesteuerte Services umsetzbar, wodurch Sie einen direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des gesamten Unternehmens haben.

Verantwortlichkeiten



Konzeption und Entwicklung von Datenmodellen auf Basis von SAP Datasphere
Erstellung von Analyse-Dashboards und Reports mit definierten KPIs in der SAP Analytics Cloud sowie Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen
Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Einführung der entwickelten Datenmodelle
Steuerung datengetriebener Projekte und Initiativen als Projekt- oder Programmmanager:in
Aufbau und Einführung eines Process-Mining-Tools für Root-Cause-Analysen



Ihr Profil



Sie haben abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
Sie begeistern sich für Daten, Analysen und Prozesse und besitzen ein ausgeprägtes konzeptionelles Denkvermögen
Sie verfügen über starke technische Fähigkeiten und können komplexe Geschäftsprobleme strukturiert lösen
Sie verstehen den geschäftlichen Kontext und besitzen die Fähigkeit den möglichen Einsatz von Datenanalysen zur Verbesserung von Abläufen zu erkennen
Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse von Methoden und Modellen der Datenanalyse
Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und haben Erfahrung mit Datenbanken sowie Datenvisualisierungstools
Sie besitzen gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL sowie Erfahrung mit SAP; Kenntnisse in Python sind von Vorteil
Sie sind in der Lage die Erkenntnisse Ihrer Arbeit verständlich, adressatengerecht und überzeugend gegenüber den Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren

Sie arbeiten in einem internationalen, kollaborativen und angenehmen Arbeitsumfeld
Sinnvolle und herausfordernde Aufgaben in einer schnell wachsenden Branche
Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur weiteren Entwicklung

Title: Senior Data Scientist
HTML:
A Rumos Consulting está a recrutar um Senior Data Scientist para o Porto (modelo presencial):


Funções:

- Explorar, analisar e avaliar dados estruturados e não estruturados, internos e externos à organização, de forma a apoiar a compreensão e antecipação das necessidades do negócio;

- Executar o ciclo de valorização dos dados, incluindo seleção, recolha, análise da qualidade, correção, preparação e aplicação de técnicas de Data Science;

- Desenvolver análises preditivas e prescritivas, implementando algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning, bem como soluções de visualização dinâmica de dados e Data Storytelling;

- Aplicar técnicas de análise de dados, incluindo estatística, Text Mining, geolocalização e extração de informação proveniente de ambientes Big Data;

- Identificar e selecionar fontes de dados relevantes, propondo recomendações para a gestão e organização de bases de dados, incluindo a conceção de Datamarts e Data Warehouses;

- Avaliar a qualidade dos dados, assegurando a sua recolha, modelação, validação, análise e integração nos sistemas de informação das áreas de negócio;

- Traduzir desafios de negócio em problemas de natureza matemática ou estatística, avaliando diferentes modelos e métodos de cálculo no contexto empresarial.


Perfil:

- Formação superior na área das Tecnologias de Informação ou similar;

- Experiência profissional mínima de 9 anos como Data Scientist;

- Experiência em análise e exploração de dados estruturados e não estruturados;

- Conhecimentos do ciclo de tratamento e valorização de dados, incluindo recolha, análise da qualidade, preparação e modelação;

- Experiência na aplicação de técnicas de Data Science, nomeadamente análise preditiva e prescritiva;

- Conhecimentos em Machine Learning e Deep Learning;

- Experiência em visualização de dados e Data Storytelling;

- Conhecimentos de estatística, Text Mining, geolocalização e análise de dados em ambientes Big Data;

- Conhecimentos na identificação e gestão de fontes de dados, bem como na conceção de Datamarts e Data Warehouses;

- Experiência na avaliação da qualidade, modelação e validação de dados;

- Capacidade para integrar dados em sistemas de informação;

- Fluência em Inglês;

- Excelentes capacidades de comunicação;

- Capacidade de análise e atenção ao detalhe.


Trabalhar connosco:

- Com mais de 30 anos de experiência, a Rumos Consulting conta com uma equipa de profissionais especializados em TI;

- Na Rumos Consulting, os consultores integram projetos altamente desafiantes, com base em tecnologia de ponta e nos mais diversos setores de atividade;

- Os consultores Rumos Consulting têm acesso a um plano de formação certificada, o que lhes proporciona uma constante atualização de competências técnicas;

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d) - Reporting & Analytics
Description:
Your role in our team

As a Data Scientist (m/f/d), you will drive data-driven decision-making across our organization. You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses



Your profile



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills
Strong technical capabilities and the ability to solve complex business challenges in a structured manner
Good understanding of business contexts and the ability to identify opportunities where data analytics can improve processes and performance
Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner



Your Benefits



Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
Meaningful and challenging responsibilities that make a difference in a fast-growing industry
Diverse opportunities for further development
Competitive compensation package
Modern office, flexible working time and remote work option

Since launching our social network in 2022, we've welcomed over 3.4 million social members who aren't just booking trips, they're messaging, finding events, meeting up and becoming powerful brand advocates. This community generates a rich proprietary dataset of 16 million+ chat messages and 17 million bookings, powering AI-driven personalisation and network effects that no generalist OTA can replicate.

We are not just another OTA - we created an entirely new category – Social Travel. If you want to shape the future of travel by putting people and shared experiences at the heart of it, you'll fit right in here - Learn more about our Team!

OUR CULTURE

At Hostelworld, our culture is a direct reflection of our customers: adventurous, curious, and social. We have a shared love of travel that fuels our work and connects us on a deeper level. It’s a fast-paced environment that blends the agility and "scrappy" resourcefulness of a start-up with the experience and ambition of a global, publicly listed company.

We are a team of pragmatic optimists who are data-obsessed and results-driven. We value a ‘test and learn’ mindset, encouraging experimentation and empowering our teams to take calculated risks. We believe in doing the right thing—for our customers, our partners, and each other. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and where every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact on our journey. We embrace the journey, not just the destination, and we seek leaders who will thrive in a dynamic environment and inspire their teams to do the same.

LOCATION🌍

This role is based in Portugal. We have an office hub in Porto available for those who prefer a hybrid model where you can spend time with colleagues in-person. You will need to be able to commute to our office hub as required from time to time.

What The Role Looks Like 🆕

Build production ML and LLM systems that improve Hostelworld discovery, relevance and efficiency. This role focuses on MCP servers, agent-facing tools, LLM applications, model evaluation, and adapting open-source or commercial models to improve accuracy, latency and cost.

What You'll Do 👩‍💻


Translate traveller, hostel and business problems into ML/LLM solutions across search, ranking, destination discovery, property Q&A, social matching and content understanding.
Design, build and operate MCP servers and agent-facing APIs that expose Hostelworld capabilities safely to LLMs and external agent ecosystems.
Build LLM applications using RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling, structured outputs, moderation and product logic.
Improve Hostelworld-specific accuracy through benchmarks, error analysis, prompt/version control, fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data and model selection.
Evaluate and adapt open-source or commercial models where they improve quality, latency, vendor flexibility or inference cost.
Own productionisation end to end: data pipelines, embeddings/features, model serving, APIs, monitoring, alerting, documentation and support.
Work with AI Gateway, data platform and engineering teams on model routing, caching, rate limits, cost observability, guardrails and provider abstraction.
Define hypotheses, run experiments and communicate technical, product and commercial impact to Product, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing and senior stakeholders.


KEY FOCUS AREA


MCP and agent visibility: hostel search, property Q&A, city/social context, deep links and logging to identify blind spots in AI-mediated travel discovery.
Hostelworld-specific LLM quality: evaluation datasets using inventory, reviews, attributes, social signals, booking context and destination data.
Cost and latency optimisation: model routing, caching, smaller models, batching, quantisation, distillation and provider selection.
Reusable infrastructure: evaluation harnesses, deployment patterns, libraries and templates for a small high-expertise ML team.


What We’re Looking For 👀

MUST HAVE


Strong Python and SQL, with modular design, testing, CI/CD, code review, documentation and operational ownership.
Production ML experience, ideally in search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation, marketplaces, travel, ecommerce or consumer products.
Practical LLM engineering: RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt management and monitoring.
Experience building ML/LLM services.
MCP servers, agentic workflows, LangGraph/LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
Strong evaluation mindset: offline benchmarks, relevance evaluation, A/B testing, error analysis, factuality/safety checks, latency and cost measurement.
Ability to reason about model trade-offs: frontier vs small model, fine-tuned vs prompted, traditional ML vs rules, and quality vs latency vs cost.
Working knowledge of cloud/data/ML infrastructure such as GCP, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Kubernetes preferred; Redis, Postgres, MongoDB/vector stores or similar also applicable.
Clear communication with engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Fine-tuning, distillation, quantisation or serving open-source models.
Agentic experience.
Multilingual travel content, review summarisation, moderation, social graphs, recommendation systems or marketplace ranking.
Synthetic data or prompt-set generation for AI visibility, competitor benchmarking or agent-behaviour measurement.


SUCCESS PROFILE


First 90 days: understands Hostelworld ranking, social travel, Q&A, AI Gateway and MCP priorities; ships or materially improves one LLM/MCP component or evaluation framework.
Six months: owns a measurable workstream improving LLM answer quality, agent discoverability, latency or cost with monitoring and product/business impact.
Long term: becomes a go-to technical owner for Hostelworld’s agentic AI and LLM infrastructure.


What We Offer 💯


Competitive salary & benefits
Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
Support for your ongoing growth & development
Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days


OUR BEHAVIOURS 🏆


Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.
Collaborate - We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.
Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.


We believe in talented and diverse teams that reflect the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we operate. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences. We lay out the above requirements to guide applicants to the experiences that we believe will allow you to be successful in the role. If you don’t meet them all, please consider applying if you think you can still perform the role as described.

Hostelworld Group plc is a ground-breaking social network-powered Online Travel Agent ("OTA") with a clear mission to help travellers find people to hang out with.

Our mission is founded on the insight that most travellers go hostelling to meet other people. Our platform connects travellers through a range of social features, including city and hostel chat rooms, AI-powered recommendations, and event discovery, facilitating real-world interactions before, during and after their trips.

Hostelworld's vision is to be the world's leading social travel platform. Since launching its social network in 2022, the Group has welcomed over 4.0 million social members, with engagement growing faster than stays booked. Social members book approximately twice as frequently as non-members and are three times more likely to use the app, demonstrating the platform's utility and its contribution to customer lifetime value.

Our proprietary dataset, spanning over 4.0 million social members, 19.0 million chat messages and 19.0 million bookings since launch, strengthens our ability to understand traveller behaviour, personalise experiences, and build network effects that differentiate Hostelworld from generalist OTAs. This data asset, which is exclusively ours and compounds in value as our community grows, underpins our AI-powered matching and recommendation capabilities.

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Ireland, Hostelworld is a recognised brand with around 275 employees, hostel and accommodation partners across more than 180 countries, and a growing suite of products including budget accommodation and Social Passes that extend the platform well beyond the traditional hostelling category.

Hostelworld has a long-standing commitment to improving the sustainability of the hostelling industry. The Group has introduced a hostel-specific Staircase to Sustainability framework, accredited by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, which helps partners adopt more sustainable practices while giving travellers clearer information for decision-making. Customers can choose to offset trip emissions, and for the fifth consecutive year the Group has retained the 'Taking Climate Action' label from South Pole.

Our Global Technology Solutions team builds digital solutions, from sensors and IoT devices to data, analytics and AI-driven capabilities, that support our ISS A/S operations across Cleaning, Workplace, Food and Technical Services.

With tech hubs in Copenhagen, Warsaw, and Porto, and teams collaborating across more than 30 countries, our ISS Tech team develops our digital solutions that have a real impact on both our customers and our people.




Location: Porto, Portugal

Work regime: Hybrid




The Job Role as Machine Learning Engineer:

We’re building AI-powered products such as our conversational analytics assistant and are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help take models from experimentation to scalable, production-grade systems.

As a key member of our Data Science and AI Solution team, you will play a crucial role in developing and deploying cutting-edge machine learning models and solutions. You'll collaborate closely with our data scientists, software engineers, and DevOps professionals to drive innovation and bring our AI-powered products to life.




What you'll do:

Contribute to building and improving LLM-based systems powering conversational AI and analytics use cases, including multi-agent pipelines and RAG architectures.
Support end-to-end MLOps pipelines for LLM applications, covering deployment, versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and retraining.
Work with DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning components into production systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, analyse data, and support the development of solutions that drive actionable insights.
Maintain and contribute to ML infrastructure on Cloud.
Explore new tools and technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our AI systems.
Stay up to date with the latest advancements in LLMs and AI to help contribute to the team's innovation roadmap

Key qualifications:

Must have:

Academic background in computer science, data science, machine learning, or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's degree).
Experience in machine learning engineering, AI development, or a related role.
Comes with solid knowledge of Python.
Comes with solid knowledge of relational databases, such as PostgreSQL.
Exposure to designing or deploying machine learning or AI models, whether in production or project settings.
English proficiency, both written and spoken.

Nice to have:

Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines.
Familiarity with LangChain / LangGraph frameworks.
Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., FAISS, pgvector) or embedding models.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerisation technologies.
Exposure to Data/AI Platforms such as Databricks or Microsoft Foundry.
Understanding of backend / API development.

Personal skills:

Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to tackling challenges.
Clear communicator, able to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Curious and eager to learn, with a genuine interest in the fast-moving AI landscape.
Collaborative and open to feedback, comfortable working across teams.




What ISS Offers You:

We focus on creating an environment where you can grow and perform at your best:

Permanent contract.
Competitive compensation package based on your experience, including private health insurance.
22 days of annual leave + 3 additional company days to recharge.
Flexible working hours and a hybrid model that supports balance and collaboration.
Continuous learning opportunities (technical and behavioural development) to support your growth.
Modern, well-equipped office in the heart of Porto.
Free parking for your convenience.
Access to ISS Tech Communities to connect, learn and share knowledge.
Free access to the company gym to support your wellbeing.
Snacks and drinks available at the office.




Why ISS

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.




ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.

Become more. Become ISS.




ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

Title: GenAI Analyst
Description:
About AUTOMAISE
AUTOMAISE is based in Braga, Portugal and is developing an Automated Machine Learning platform to build productivity solutions for Operations and Customer Care. We offer a no-code/low-code platform that enables brands to automate complex processes within incredibly short timeframes, helping organizations supercharge digital transformation strategies.
Job Overview:
We're looking for a Generative AI Analyst with a focus on enhancing our chatbot and voicebot solutions. This role is ideal for someone passionate about improving AI interactions and making digital communication feel more human. You'll work on refining the conversational abilities of our AI by testing, iterating, and optimizing prompts and knowledge bases.
What you’ll do:

Iteratively fine-tune GenAI prompts and parameters and adjust knowledge bases to enhance conversation quality and user experience.
Perform quality analysis of chatbot interaction logs, prompts, enabling continuous improvement of conversational accuracy and user experience.
Apply basic Python skills for data analysis and solutions testing.
Collaborate with the AI team to implement changes that improve bot performance and customer satisfaction.
Conduct thorough testing of our chatbot and voicebot solutions to identify areas for improvement.
Analyze user feedback and interaction data to guide your optimization efforts.
Ensure our bots' language capabilities are inclusive, accurate, and culturally relevant, with particular emphasis on Portuguese and English.

What we’re looking for:

2 years minimum of experience in a data analyst role and an academic degree in a Computer Science field, Mathematics or Statistics.
Strong analytical skills, with a keen eye for detail and a creative problem-solving approach.
Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, etc.) and their strengths/limitations.
Ability to design, test, and iterate prompts systematically.
Understanding of prompt engineering principles (e.g., role prompting, chain-of-thought structuring, few-shot examples, and evaluation strategies).
Basic knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis.
Exposure to vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively across different departments.
Passion for AI and a user-centric approach to technology development.
Basic understanding of APIs is a plus, but not required.
Experience with chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus, but not required.
Excellent command of Portuguese and English.

What you’ll get from us:

Competitive Salary: Attractive compensation based on your experience and role.
Generous Time Off: Enjoy 22 days of paid annual leave plus 5 extra days.
Flexible Work Options: Hybrid work regime.
Performance Bonuses: Earn bonuses based on your achievements.
Health Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
Career Growth: Opportunities for personal and professional development.
Continuous Learning: Access to training programs to enhance your skills.
Supportive Team: Join a dynamic, agile, and expanding team.
Growth Opportunities: Thrive in a growing company with a strong career path.
Positive Environment: Enjoy a collaborative and open work culture.
Unique Office Space: Work in an inspiring office at Braga’s city center with a historic medieval wall backdrop.
Work-Life Balance: Embrace a balanced work-life with flexibility and support.
Fun Perks: Engage in company events, treats, and team-building activities.

Ready to Take the Next Step? APPLY NOW!
We are excited to hear everything about you and why you think this role is a fit for you. Please reach out with your LinkedIn profile/CV, and don’t hesitate to contact us with any questions at jobs@automaise.com
